agent: Codex parent with CCR implementation worker and two read-only Codex auditors
implementation: Added src/samurai/calibration.py, a bounded label-free powered Bernoulli Dawid-Skene estimator over binary latent mask classes.

Each expert report becomes a hard vote with confidence |2p-1|. The expectation step scales the Dawid-Skene likelihood ratio by report confidence; beta-smoothed maximisation fits per-expert sensitivity, false-positive rate, and positive prior.
Calibration requires at least three aligned tensor experts. Two label-free raters are non-identifiable and fail closed.
The positive latent class follows the panel mean-vote convention. Per-expert agreement and the first expert anchor agreement are separate report fields; no expert is a hidden authority.
Confidence weights normalize soft agreement above chance with the estimated latent field. Identical or wholly uninformative panels fall back to equal weights.
Reports retain detailed expert metrics, normalized confidence weights, latent positive/selected fractions, pairwise Dice/Brier/disagreement, and per-frame latent/support/disagreement summaries.

The generated ensemble config preserves paths, prompts, representations, temperatures, and fusion while replacing only weights. It carries source-config and expert-tensor SHA-256 provenance into both calibration and fusion reports.
Added the samurai calibrate CLI with smoothing, tolerance, iteration, sampling, pixel-budget, seed, latent-output, config-output, and report options.
Fusion and calibration now share ensemble.expert_probabilities, ensuring probability logit conversion and temperature scaling cannot diverge.

Fusion now fails closed on non-finite outputs, falls back to normalized base weights when every entropy weight is zero, and enforces the threshold as a minimum score floor in spatial top-k so an area quota cannot promote weak evidence.
